name: AMD GPU Memory Model
description: The memory model underlying AMD's GCN, CDNA and RDNA GPUs, built on the HSA heterogeneous, scoped, release-consistency framework. Memory operations carry explicit scope qualifiers (work-group, agent/device, system) and cache-control hints; ordering between threads holds only within a shared scope.

catSupport.note: HSA-style scoped release consistency, specified in prose: the scoped-DRF guarantees are per-execution conditions that herd's bell/cat scopes can express, but no cat model is published.
